task.title: Record the failure-analysis request-provenance integration and its real-model result on L5b and L1
task.objective: At e27e15bd buildFailureAnalysisRequest reads L5a's requestRelations: request lines state what the runner observed, the failed step's own request is ranked first after the baseline's citations, a request issued after the failure is barred from primary evidence, and a request without provenance is byte-identical. Technical verification passes (verify:ai-error-analysis 401/401 with seven mutations caught, verify:request-provenance 81/0, every live row delivered and saved with citations 33/33). Model quality is not met on the real Qwen3.5-0.8B: labelled set 9/11 vs 9/11, six real-runner provenance cases AI 0/6 vs baseline 2/6, all 17 rows AI 9/17 vs baseline 11/17 (improvement -2, 8 false attributions), the model never citing the failed step's own request. Append a note to awkit-djnl.8 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the change, the technical result, the quality result and the remaining blocker. Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the change commit, its technical result and its unmet model-quality result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` (303 issues) and the already-edited state documents: 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. verify:verifier-classification reconciled 257 scripts. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.
